content.short: Goki provides an interface to create, manage, and audit multisig wallets on Solana.
content.description: The Goki Smart Wallet is a programmable multisig wallet that provides signing rules through two subaccount types. Derived accounts require the owner to approve each transaction before it can be signed, ensuring oversight of activity from those accounts. Owner-invoker accounts enable designated members to sign transactions without prior approval, enabling collaborative signing when appropriate. Wallet owners can be defined at setup and can be edited later as needs change, giving you control over who can sign and when.
content.meta: Goki offers tools to create, manage, and audit multisig wallets on Solana. Discover Goki and other Web3 Wallets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
